messages.author: 4265a8904b860d8a
messages.subject: html hyperlink
parts:
Is there a way to add hyperlink text to the application? For instance, in my application I would like to link to another website where I have more information on the tool. I was thinking I might be able to put in helpText in the sidebar that says 

For more information on this tool please go to the following address: here would be the address.

One could copy and paste the address but I thought it would be nice to provide a link. Thanks.

Tychele

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: html hyperlink
parts:
Yes, you could do this:

helpText(
  "For more information on this tool please go to the following address: ",
  a(href="http://www.example.com", target="_blank", "Example")
)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: html hyperlink
parts: If the document is going to be pretty static, you can put it in a "www" subdirectory of the main application. Then just a("AFIR 2013", "AFIR2013.pdf", target="_blank") will work (i.e. the href parameter does NOT need "www" in the actual URL).
